articles.title: Braided Junction
articles.summary: Bold crossing tow bundles with raised overpasses and recessed underpasses, resin pockets, strong relief. A coarse woven or basket-like shimmer in the lit zone; the plus shapes are readable as a bold regular check.
articles.what: Crossing tow bundles, raised overpasses, recessed underpasses, resin pockets and stitch collars. Up close: Chunky crossed bars and plus-shaped junctions about 30-40 px across on a regular grid, with small round resin pockets and diagonal stitch ticks between them. Bright bar arms read as raised overpasses, dark arms as underpasses; it feels like fat woven tows. From a distance: A coarse woven or basket-like shimmer in the lit zone; the plus shapes are readable as a bold regular check. It changes the shine only, never the colour. Channels it touches: metal, roughness, clearcoat. Group: Weave & Composite (Surface library tab of the spec overlay picker). Texture detail: micro.
when: Best on: hood, roof, hero panel.
how: Click a zone card and expand SPEC OVERLAYS.
Click + ADD SPEC OVERLAY, open the Surface library tab and the group "Weave & Composite", or search for "Braided Junction".
Click it, then click Add this overlay in the Inspect surface window.
Set Strength (default 50%) and tick the Metallic, Roughness and Clearcoat boxes you want.
Use Size and Rotation to make the texture finer, then render.
tips: Hood, roof and trunk where the large weave can read
Side panels as a bold texture
Numbers should be bold and light-coloured; the chunky bars can break up thin outlines.
Strong for a spec pattern: bright crossed bars stand out clearly in the highlight over satin
Pairs well with: matte, satin, gloss.
pitfalls: Not carbon twill: the bars cross at right angles with plus junctions, not a diagonal weave
Not a plaid or check paint: no colour, only shine
Avoid: small trim where the weave scale is lost, busy liveries that fight the pattern.
articles.intent_note: A spec pattern changes the shine only: metal, roughness and clearcoat, never the paint colour.
articles.paint_advice: It cannot recolour anything. Metal added to a light paint looks bright; metal added to a dark paint stays dark, because metal reflection inherits the paint colour. Pair it with a paint that gives the gloss difference something to show on.

combos.why: Up to five overlays stack in order; a strong overlay can wash out the ones below it.
The blend mode decides how this overlay meets the base shine. Normal is the safe start.
Coat values 1 to 15 and roughness under 15 on non-chrome pixels are raised to safe values on export.

examples.title: Add it as an overlay
examples.goal: Layer Braided Junction over a base finish.
examples.result: The shine of the zone gets this texture while the colours stay put.
